fields.materials: Application Materials " * " means necessary documents that you must provide in your application. If you want to book our translation service , please pay and book it at least 2 weeks before the application deadline for submission of all documents; If you want to book our guardian service , you need to pay and book it 2 months before the application deadline, just in case your application fails because of failed to submit application documents on time. * 1. Passport photo of the applicant within recent six months (full face, front view, bare-head) in JPG format. * 2. A copy of the personal page of your valid foreign passport Applicants currently residing in mainland China must also provide a scanned copy of the currently valid visa page or residence permit page. * 3. Non-criminal Record (valid for 6 months). * 4. Certificate of HSK * 5. A scanned notarized copy of high school diploma Notarized Chinese or English translations is required for certificates in any language other than Chinese or English; if the applicant is a would-be graduate, the current school shall issue a pre-graduation certificate. * 6. A scanned notarized copy of high school transcript Notarized Chinese or English translations is required for certificates in any language other than Chinese or English. * 7. Curriculum Vitae 8. Professional level supporting materials (performance videos, creative works, etc. that can represent the professional level of the applicant). Tips: For applicants who are in China: If you are an employee, you still need to provide employment separation certificate and your current residence permit. If you are a student, you need to provide transfer certificate, leaving certificate, certificate of attendance rate issued by previous school and your current residence permit.
fields.requirements: Entry Requirements 1. Applicant shall be in good physical and mental health； 2. Applicants shall have good moral character and no criminal record; be willing to abide by Chinese laws and regulation, as well as the rules of the XACM. 3. Applicants shall be between the age of 18 and 35 (as of March 30 2023). 4. Applicants shall be non-Chinese citizens with a valid foreign passport. For the applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants must hold passport or citizenship certificate of their current countries for at least 4 years in addition to the 2-year “proof of residence” in recent 4 years (as of March 30, 2023. actual residence in a foreign country for more than 9 months in a year can be counted as one year, subject to the entry and exit stamps). Applicants whose one or both parents are Chinese citizens must provide one of the following supporting documents: 1) The certificate proving that the applicants obtained the foreign nationality at birth; 2) For applicants who used to be Chinese citizens but later immigrated to other countries, these applicants shall provide the certificates of cancellation of Chinese nationality. 5. Applicants shall hold at least a high school diploma or graduation certificate. 6. Applicants shall have Chinese language proficiency equivalent to or above HSK Level 4.
